Halloween double bill, Strathbungo Film Society, 31 October 2024. Took the noir slot that week (see [[Film noir watchlist]]).

## Programme

- 19:00 doors, intro music on the Minilogue (patch P-041, see [[Synth patch notes]])
- 19:15 "The Wicker Man" (1973, Robin Hardy), 88 min theatrical cut
- 20:50 break, 20 min
- 21:10 "Night of the Demon" (1957, Jacques Tourneur), 95 min
- 22:50 out, the hall needs us gone by 23:00

## Checklist

- [x] Filmbank licences for both, ref FB-59120, £170 total
- [x] Projector bulb checked, 1,840 hours on it
- [x] Fake cobwebs from the Pound Shop, £6, Ishbel's job
- [x] Soundbar plus the sub from my flat, see [[Sound design]] on why horror needs low end
- [ ] Locrian sting before the second film (bottled it after the laughter, see below)
- [x] Toffee apples, 40, made by Ishbel's mum

## Log

- 19:20 Projector cut out during the opening credits. HDMI cable. Swapped, lost 4 minutes.
- 20:40 Wicker Man ending, total silence. Good silence.
- 20:55 Played the Locrian sting as a joke intro, people laughed. Wasn't meant to be a joke.
- 22:45 Fire demon effect in "Night of the Demon" got applause. The producer added that creature against Tourneur's wishes, which I told the room, and Fergus argued it was the best bit.

## Numbers

44 tickets (sold out plus four on chairs from the kitchen), £5 for the double bill, £220. After licence and cobwebs, £44 profit. Do it again in 2025, maybe "Carnival of Souls" (1962). Caffeine at 22:00 was a mistake, didn't sleep till 3 (see [[Caffeine cutoff]]).
